page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.1-8 is an Arm-based flexible virtual machine instance engineered for tasks that require a higher memory allocation per compute unit. Powered by an Ampere Altra processor operating on the arm64 instruction set, the instance provides 1 physical core that correlates to 1 dedicated vCPU. The processor runs at a fixed 3.0 GHz clock rate with 1 thread per core, ensuring uninterrupted single-threaded compute without performance interference from hyperthreading.

Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB of RAM, resulting in an 8.0 GB per core ratio. This elevated memory density positions the instance appropriately for memory-oriented processes where execution demands low compute footprint alongside room for cached datasets or memory-resident runtimes. No local disk storage is included directly within the configuration, meaning all persistence and operating system storage must be mounted via remote block volumes. Additionally, the instance features no GPU accelerators, focusing purely on general-purpose 64-bit Arm CPU execution.

From a networking standpoint, the instance comes provisioned with 1 complimentary public IPv4 address for ingress and egress routing. In terms of efficiency, the use of custom resource sizing on the Ampere Altra architecture provides economical operation without paying for unneeded virtual CPUs. VM.Standard.A1.Flex.1-8 is suited for running lightweight relational or key-value caches, staging environments, network proxies, single-tenant web backends, and low-traffic containerized microservices.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.1-8 is an entry-level compute instance tailored for memory-centric, lightweight workloads. Driven by the 64-bit Arm architecture, the instance incorporates a single dedicated physical core from an Ampere Altra processor operating at a sustained 3.0 GHz clock speed with single-thread execution. The platform is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a generous 8:1 gigabyte-to-core ratio that accommodates processes requiring substantial working memory without necessitating additional compute capacity. There is no bundled local storage included with the instance, making it reliant on external network-attached block volumes for persistent data operations. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs present. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is provisioned directly with the server. VM.Standard.A1.Flex.1-8 delivers cost efficiency through resource-proportional Arm provisioning, making it well-suited for lightweight databases, small in-memory caches, development environments, and microservices.
